items.title: Bayer’s heart failure drug bound for NHS on NICE recommendation
items.summary: Bayer's Kerendia will become available to English patients with chronic heart failure with preserved or mildly reduced ejection fraction.

items.title: FDA grants traditional approval to Novartis’ Fabhalta for IgAN
items.summary: The FDA has issued traditional approval to Novartis for Fabhalta to slow the decline of kidney function in adults with primary IgAN who are at risk of disease progression.

items.title: MSD wins FDA approval for cholesterol pill to help plug Keytruda void
items.summary: MSD has outpaced rivals to market the first PCSK9 inhibitor in pill form for patients with high cholesterol.

items.title: JCVI issues recommendation on adolescent MenB vaccination in UK
items.summary: The UK’s Joint Committee on Vaccination and Immunisation (JCVI) has recommended a routine programme with the 4CMenB vaccine for adolescents.

items.title: UK commits to pharma IP protection in Swiss trade deal
items.summary: The pharma industry welcomed the pledge, which marked the first-time drug IP has explicitly been stated in a free trade agreement
